items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I first ran into Stan Fischelson up there, he was 16 and I was about 14.

ctx.x: Was Bernie Glow or Stan Fishelson playing most of the lead trumpet?

They split it, Stan Fishelson was a marvelous trumpet player, he was the best in his day, as a lead, like a pure lead sound, like that’s the guy you hear on top in, “Early Autumn,” for instance, just a wonderful concept. He’s a guy I ran into in the mountains – I forgot to mention that whole thing, before I was ever with Venuti, when I was a junior in high school, I’d spend my summer vacations working in the Borscht Belt, playing up at the summer hotels and I first ran into Stan Fischelson up there, he was 16 and…
Stan died pretty young didn’t he?
